findings.message: This round makes `committedAt` required on `SyncInput` and on `markSynced` (line 243), and now every `sync_proposal` and self-sync write moves the stale mark with it. Neither schema has the future-date bound that `PushInput` has (push.ts:36, `SKEW_MS`). The `sync_proposal` MCP tool schema (mcp.ts:79) doesn't have it either. The rule "a commit time from a skewed clock must not make every later push stale" therefore exists only in push.ts. `markSyncedRows` uses `greatest()`, so a future mark can never be lowered. Fix: define the bounded `committedAt` schema once, export it, and use it in `PushInput`, `SyncInput`, `markSynced` and the `sync_proposal` tool. Add a variant test for a future `committedAt` on each path: push, `sync_proposal` and self-sync.
findings.scenario: CI's clock reads 2027, or a payload is written by hand. CI calls `sync_proposal` for FLT-102 with committedAt 2027-03-01, or the self-sync CLI runs with a skewed commit date. FLT-102's `synced_commit_at` becomes 2027-03-01. Until March 2027, every correct `sync_specclaw` push for FLT-102 on any branch is skipped as 'stale: last synced from a newer commit'.

findings.message: The withdraw fix only covers the run that first withdraws a proposal. On every later self-sync, line 77 skips rows that already have `meta.withdrawn` set. Those rows are left out of `same` and get no `syncProposal`, so their stale mark stays at the commit that first withdrew them. That is the same unchanged-row hole that round 4 fixed for present proposals, now in the withdrawn variant: main at a newer commit still says the change is gone, but the mark doesn't move. `applyPush` then accepts any default-branch push dated after the first withdrawal, and `desired()` builds `meta` without `withdrawn`, so the push brings the proposal back. Fix: put already-withdrawn keys that are still missing into the `markSynced` key list (`same`), so the mark moves for every proposal the self-sync read, absent ones included. Add a table row to the AC-8 test: withdraw at T1, self-sync again at T3 with the folder still gone, then a default-branch push at T2 (T1 < T2 < T3) must be skipped as stale.
findings.scenario: 12:40: the self-sync withdraws FLT-102, so its mark is 12:40. 13:00: the self-sync runs again with 102 still absent; the row is skipped and the mark stays 12:40. A developer whose local main is at a 12:50 commit, which still has 102, then runs sync_specclaw on main with committedAt 12:50. The stale check passes (12:40 < 12:50), and upsertSpecProposal writes meta without `withdrawn`. FLT-102 is back in lists and counts, although main at 13:00 says it was removed.
